items.exampleEn: She bequeathed her house to the local library.
items.exampleZh: 她把房子遺贈給當地的圖書館。

items.exampleEn: Some people worry that video games brainwash young players.
items.exampleZh: 有些人擔心電子遊戲會對年輕玩家洗腦。

items.exampleEn: Few writers have immortalized a city as well as he did.
items.exampleZh: 很少有作家能像他那樣，讓一座城市永垂不朽。

items.exampleEn: The old temple is a place of veneration for many people.
items.exampleZh: 那座古廟是許多人崇敬的地方。

items.exampleEn: In many cultures, people venerate their ancestors.
items.exampleZh: 在許多文化中，人們會敬奉祖先。

items.exampleEn: The domestication of rice in Asia started long ago.
items.exampleZh: 稻米在亞洲的馴化很久以前就開始了。

items.exampleEn: Wild goats were domesticated in this area thousands of years ago.
items.exampleZh: 這一帶的野山羊在幾千年前就被馴化了。

items.exampleEn: The film is about a man who escapes from years of brainwashing.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影講的是一個男人擺脫多年洗腦的故事。

items.sentenceEn: Some ancient peoples venerated the sun as a god.
items.sentenceZh: 有些古代民族把太陽當成神來敬奉。

items.audioEn: My teacher bequeathed his old violin to me.
items.audioZh: 我的老師把他的舊小提琴遺贈給了我。
options: He sold it online
He gave it to a music school
He left it to the speaker
He broke it by accident

items.sentenceEn: The singer was immortalized in a famous painting.
items.sentenceZh: 那位歌手因為一幅名畫而永垂不朽。

items.sentenceEn: Cats probably domesticated themselves by living near farms.
items.sentenceZh: 貓大概是因為住在農場附近，而自我馴化的。

items.stemEn: After years of ____, the members of the group believed everything their leader said.
items.stemZh: 經過多年的洗腦，團體成員相信領袖說的每一句話。
options: detriment
manicure
brainwashing
climax

items.stemEn: Earlier generations ____ us many beautiful old buildings.
items.stemZh: 前人留給我們許多美麗的老建築。
options: veneration
plunged
domesticated
bequeathed

items.passageEn: A new exhibition at the city museum tells the long story of dogs and people. It explains that the domestication of dogs began when wolves stayed near human camps for food. Over time, people learned to domesticate them for hunting and guarding. In some ancient cultures, dogs were even objects of veneration, and artists immortalized them in stone. One notable piece is a small statue that a rich family bequeathed to the museum in 1920. The final room shows how modern advertising uses cute puppies, and asks visitors whether this is clever marketing or a gentle kind of brainwashing.
items.passageZh: 市立博物館的新展覽講述了狗與人類的漫長故事。展覽說明，狗的馴化始於狼為了食物而留在人類營地附近。久而久之，人們學會馴養牠們來打獵和看守。在一些古代文化中，狗甚至是崇敬的對象，藝術家也用石頭讓牠們永垂不朽。其中一件值得注意的作品，是一個富有家庭在 1920 年遺贈給博物館的小雕像。最後一間展室展示現代廣告如何利用可愛的小狗，並請參觀者思考：這是聰明的行銷，還是一種溫和的洗腦？

questions.questionZh: 根據展覽，狗的馴化是怎麼開始的？
options: 人們把野狼抓回家當寵物養大
狼為了食物留在營地附近
古代藝術家把狼刻在石頭上
富有的家庭開始買賣小狗賺錢

questions.questionZh: 最後一間展室請參觀者思考什麼？
options: 博物館裡哪一件石雕是最古老的
狗和狼之間最大的差別是什麼
廣告用小狗是行銷還是洗腦
要不要在家裡養一隻可愛的小狗

items.promptZh: 這部電影讓那位老漁夫的故事永垂不朽。
referenceEn: The film immortalized the old fisherman's story.
The story of the old fisherman was immortalized by the film.
rubricZh: immortalize 是及物動詞，表示「使不朽、使永遠被記住」（例如 immortalized the story 等）
「老漁夫的故事」可寫，例如 the old fisherman's story、the story of the old fisherman 等

items.instructionZh: 用 brainwash 造一個句子，說說你覺得廣告或網路怎麼影響人的想法。
referenceEn: I think some ads try to brainwash children into wanting expensive toys.
We should not let online videos brainwash us into thinking everyone else is perfect.
rubricZh: brainwash 是及物動詞，表示「洗腦」，用法例如 brainwash someone、brainwash someone into doing… 等
句子要說到你自己的看法

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：mcq "In her will, she ____ all her paintings to the city museum." 與單字卡例句 "She bequeathed her house to the local library." 主詞同為 she、句型同為 bequeath X to 公共機構、情境同為把財產留給公共機構，三項只換了受詞，違反情境不可雷同規則（§11-4）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 The old farmer ____ his land to the town, and it is now a public park.，代入後只有 bequeathed 成立

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：「自己被馴化的」語意矛盾、不通順（domesticated themselves＝自我馴化）；建議「貓大概是因為住在農場附近，自己馴化了自己」或「…而自我馴化」。
執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：domesticate 卡與閱讀都是「人類為用途馴養動物」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 Wild goats were domesticated in this area thousands of years ago.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 3：與 l01、l02 同屬「人們崇敬過去的人物」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改成崇敬自然物 Some ancient peoples venerated the sun as a god.（與單字卡的祖先情境也錯開）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 自查修正：自查：my uncle 譯「叔叔」多加了父系資訊
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改 my teacher，中譯與題目同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：immortalize 是及物動詞，表示「使不朽、使永遠被記住」（例如 immortalized the story 等）／「老漁夫的故事」可寫，例如 the old fisherman's story、the story of the old fisherman 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：brainwash 是及物動詞，表示「洗腦」，用法例如 brainwash someone、brainwash someone into doing… 等／句子要說到你自己的看法

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：最終複審 7：mcq 與 bequeath 卡都是 bequeath N to 公共機構
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改用「留給後人」義、雙受詞句型 Earlier generations ____ us many beautiful old buildings.，代入後只有 bequeathed 成立
